timeline.body:
Fixes: #113754

For a specific seed, the test tried to mutate a page made of all UNSUPPORTED columns, leading to an infinite loop (unsupported values are always null)

timeline.author: Luigi Dell'Aquila

timeline.body: Might be worth adding a comment here that for UNSUPPORTED the `null` value is used throughout the test suite, thus the check here.

timeline.author: Luigi Dell'Aquila
